common.disclaimer_full: PackWise AI operates as a predictive decision-support system calculating barrier requirements (OTR, WVTR), shelf-life kinetics, and material alternatives. Outputs do not substitute for mandatory empirical shelf-life testing, microbial challenge studies, or statutory regulatory migration certifications (such as US FDA 21 CFR 177, EU 10/2011, or FSSAI).

landing.hero_title: Intelligent Food Packaging Material Recommendation System
landing.hero_subtitle: Get smart packaging suggestions for your food products. Optimize shelf-life, barrier protection (OTR & WVTR), food safety, and sustainability in seconds.
landing.challenge_subtitle: Selecting packaging without scientific barrier analysis leads to spoilage, regulatory failure, and unnecessary plastic waste.
landing.prob_1_desc: Up to 30% of perishable and dry food products spoil prematurely due to mismatched oxygen (OTR) and water vapor (WVTR) barrier transmission rates.
landing.prob_2_desc: Small food processors and packaging engineers waste weeks and substantial capital on physical trial-and-error shelf-life trials without predictive barrier models.
landing.prob_3_desc: Balancing stringent oxygen barrier performance with circular, mono-material recycling streams is complex and counter-intuitive.
landing.sol_subtitle: PackWise AI matches food degradation vectors with precise polymer barrier properties and environmental sustainability criteria.
landing.feat_1_desc: Differentiates climacteric fruits and high-respiration produce to recommend breathable or laser micro-perforated films, preventing anaerobic spoilage.
landing.feat_2_desc: Derives strict maximum OTR (≤ 1.0–5.0 cm³/m²·d) and UV barrier requirements for high-fat snacks, roasted nuts, and dairy powders.
landing.feat_3_desc: Computes critical WVTR thresholds (≤ 1.5 g/m²·d) to safeguard crispy snacks from softening and dry powders from moisture caking.
landing.feat_4_desc: Mandates cold-impact sealants and high puncture resistance for frozen foods, eliminating brittle polymers prone to freezer burn.
landing.feat_5_desc: Dynamically balances barrier protection, carbon footprint, recyclability rating, and cost efficiency according to your priorities.
landing.feat_6_desc: Zero tolerance for non-certified polymers. Evaluates every candidate against US FDA 21 CFR 177, EU 10/2011, and FSSAI standards.
landing.workflow_subtitle: A transparent, deterministic 4-stage decision pipeline rooted in food chemistry and packaging engineering.
landing.step_1_desc: Input commodity characteristics (moisture, pH, oil/fat, respiration rate) or pick from preloaded presets.
landing.step_2_desc: The engine models environmental deltas, microbial moisture limits, oxidation sensitivity, and ASTM barrier thresholds.
landing.step_3_desc: Incompatible materials (e.g. non-perforated barriers on respiring produce) are disqualified with scientific explanations.
landing.step_4_desc: Receive primary material structure, gauge thickness, MAP gas composition, eco-alternatives, and technical spec sheets.
landing.presets_subtitle: Instant packaging barrier calculations available for common high-risk and high-volume food sectors.

form.title: Packaging Recommendation Form
form.subtitle: Configure food preservation parameters to calculate ASTM barrier physics and optimal materials.
form.sec_1_desc: Basic food commodity identification and chemical characteristics.
form.commodity_placeholder: e.g., Fresh Tomato, Potato Chips, Roasted Almonds
form.commodity_helper: Enter the commercial food product or raw produce name.
form.commodity_tooltip: The target food item to be packaged. Used for microbial, respiratory, and lipid risk identification.
form.category_helper: Broad classification determines baseline degradation pathways.
form.category_tooltip: Categorization guides default permeability limits and mechanical requirements.
form.moisture_helper: Governs critical water vapor transmission (WVTR) limit.
form.moisture_tooltip: High moisture foods require breathability or microbial barrier; dry foods require high water vapor barrier to prevent sogginess.
form.exact_moisture_helper: Laboratory measured water content by weight.
form.ph_helper: Low-acid foods (pH > 4.6) require stringent pathogen defense.
form.ph_tooltip: Determines susceptibility to bacterial pathogens (e.g. Clostridium botulinum) and chemical polymer corrosion.
form.oil_fat_helper: High-fat items require strict oxygen (OTR) and light barriers.
form.oil_fat_tooltip: High lipids accelerate oxidative rancidity, off-odors, and loss of nutritional vitamins.
form.respiration_helper: Respiring produce requires breathable EMAP films.
form.respiration_tooltip: Living produce consumes O2 and emits CO2. Hermetic barrier films without micro-perforations cause anaerobic fermentation and ethanol off-flavor.
form.sec_2_desc: Thermal environment, transit logistics, and shelf-life requirements.
form.shelf_life_target_tooltip: Determines required barrier thickness and gas barrier transmission resistance.
form.logistics_range_helper: Defines puncture and vibration strength criteria.
form.logistics_range_tooltip: Longer transit paths require stronger tensile modulus and pinhole fatigue resistance.
form.shelf_life_days_helper: Target shelf life under specified storage conditions.
form.transport_condition_helper: Supply chain handling and climate exposure profile.
form.storage_temp_helper: Ambient or cold chain set point.
form.sec_3_desc: Structural form factor and circular economy priorities.
form.format_helper: Physical style and machinery sealing configuration.
form.format_tooltip: Affects surface area to volume ratio, seal width, and gas flush headspace.
form.sustainability_helper: Guides weighting between recyclability, bio-polymers, and cost.
form.sustainability_tooltip: PackWise AI multi-criteria decision analysis incorporates environmental impact scores.
